tool_schemas.name: book_trip
tool_schemas.description: Book a flight and a hotel together and charge the corporate card.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. The key is recorded only when a request completes. A request that failed partway is not recorded: part of it may have taken effect, and repeating it with the same key runs it again. After a failure or timeout, check current state before retrying.

tool_schemas.name: book_flight
tool_schemas.description: Book a single flight (charges the corporate card).

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. The key is recorded when a request completes; a repeated request with the same key is not executed again.

tool_schemas.name: book_hotel
tool_schemas.description: Book a hotel stay (charges the corporate card).

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. The key is recorded when a request completes; a repeated request with the same key is not executed again.

tool_schemas.name: list_reservations
tool_schemas.description: List a traveler's reservations (including cancelled ones).

tool_schemas.name: cancel_reservation
tool_schemas.description: Cancel a reservation and refund it.

trace.error_message: Request to book_trip timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
The trip is fully booked. Here's what happened:

**Flight:** The combined `book_trip` request timed out after 30 seconds. Checking the reservations showed the flight part had gone through (reservation R0001), so I did not retry it — that would have risked a duplicate charge.

**Hotel:** I booked the missing hotel stay separately with `book_hotel` (reservation R0002).

**Final booked trip for Dana Lee:**
- ✈️ Flight F100 — SFO → JFK, nonstop, 2026-11-12, $289 (cheapest nonstop available; F120 was cheaper but had 1 stop)
- 🏨 Midtown Lodge (H1), NYC — check-in 2026-11-12, 2 nights, $189/night ($378 total; cheapest NYC option under $250/night)

Both reservations are confirmed, for a total cost of **$667** (no manager approval needed, since it's under the $1000 threshold).

transcript.reasoning_content: Search flights and hotels in parallel.
Cheapest nonstop: F100 $289. Cheapest hotel under $250/night: H1 $189/night, total $378. Total trip cost $667 < $1000, no approval needed. Book together.

transcript.content: The booking request timed out, so I'll check whether it actually completed before retrying.
transcript.reasoning_content: Timeout. Check current state before retrying.

transcript.content: The flight went through but the hotel didn't, so I'll book the hotel separately.
transcript.reasoning_content: The timeout partially took effect: the flight is booked, but no hotel reservation. I should book just the hotel now (booking the whole trip again would double-book the flight).
